prompt: Unchanged #102 direction-only system prompt in every semantic observation; unchanged sampling-control prompt.

construction.question: Can the model construct a forward/reverse plan given an exact predicate, start and graph IRI?
construction.panel: All 60 mechanically generated explicit-predicate-development-v1 questions, original order; original oracle vocabulary, no added metadata. No historical natural-language comparison is a causal ablation.
construction.expected: Original source-derived five fields and graph-qualified witnesses, including empty paths. Empty paths still require the explicit requested candidate; literal objects are never starts.
construction.primary: Exact status and all five fields, separately forward/reverse and witnessed/empty_path; every field and wrong-start/direction individually. Mechanical request fidelity, not natural-language semantic correctness.

metadata.question: Does verified retained source metadata improve natural-language interpretation at fixed vocabulary membership?
metadata.panel: All 30 unchanged exposed natural-language evaluation questions plus the retained v1e-label-explicit source-injection control, each paired with/without metadata; original full oracle membership only.
metadata.only_factor: Predicate source_metadata arrays: empty versus exact mapped retained labels/descriptions. Source graph/role/numeric membership, original question, system prompt, entity names, usages, collision warnings, grammar, runtime, sampling and scoring references identical within each pair. Packet identities differ only in host sidecars. No explicit-IRI rewording in this experiment.
metadata.order: Original question order, injection last; no_metadata first for even zero-based pair index, metadata first for odd index. Single sequential process, fresh independent completion per observation.
metadata.primary: Paired change in unchanged exposed-AI-reference agreement, with all scheduled and paired-completed denominators. Five fields and model-origin statuses independently; forward/reverse and control categories separately. Missing outcomes are null, never successes. Unchanged ambiguity audit and source insufficiency remain separate from reference agreement.
metadata.negative_controls: Non-Wikidata relations have no newly mapped meanings. Report these separately from relations with verified metadata; do not invent W3C/Schema/GEMET property meanings from local names or concept definitions.

controls.ambiguous_identity: eva-20 Campus; source-label ambiguity eva-06 retained as an exposed-reference tension, never relabeled
controls.source_injection: v1e-label-explicit in both metadata arms; every source string untrusted/inert; no generated query execution
controls.stale_packet: Model-free rejection of changed source, metadata, graph-qualified binding, context or saved packet identity before Rust preview
controls.incorrect_direction: Model-free intentionally flipped candidate may pass Rust but must fail field scoring; all scheduled explicit reverse probes remain included
controls.native: Before any future generation: fresh unchanged host/resource admission, asset checks, constrained/unconstrained sampling controls and fresh native template/token-array parity for EVERY exact message; 12 existing grammar accept/reject controls. Fatal integrity/runtime/resource failure stops remaining requests; ordinary interpretation errors remain observations.

resource_limits: Inherit original #102 config verbatim: 1024 MiB swap admission, 24 GiB sampled process-tree RSS, 16384 context, 512 output reserve, input+512 strictly below 16384, 4 CPU threads, zero GPU layers, concurrency 1, 300-second completion deadline, zero retries. No limit relaxation or downloads.
interpretation: Explicit-IRI failures with complete vocabulary indicate request-to-plan construction problems even without predicate meanings. Explicit success plus metadata-only paired gains is evidence consistent with missing source meaning; no gain does not prove metadata is irrelevant. Persistent ambiguity, language mismatch and exposed-reference tensions can remain. Synthetic checks prove engineering contracts only. Rust acceptance, reference agreement and independent semantic correctness are separate.
reporting: Retain original raw bytes/SSE, every failed/unattempted request, prompt/token/native parity, GBNF, Rust preview, latency/RSS, model status and five fields; report full and paired denominators, target-metadata availability, exact source evidence and rationale contradictions. Human correctness stays null; no superiority/readiness or real-world truth claim. No RDF execution.
authorization: Preparation, registration and scoring are model-free. No native runner is exposed here. A future runner/review and separate explicit authorization naming this exact archive, reviewed revision, 126-request cap and fresh output are required. No merge, holdout, #75, reference rewrite or source download is authorized.
